posts.title: ON THE BRIDGE AT 4:30 PM
posts.description: Late fall, and daylight hours are short. It was only 4:30, but looks much later in this photo. The rain and overcast skies didn't help either.

posts.title: RAIN, RAIN, DON'T GO AWAY
posts.description: Contrary to the saying about rain going away, downtown yesterday was full of umbrella sellers who want to keep the rain and stay in business.

posts.title: SPLASHES OF COLOR...AND WATER
posts.description: It has been really rainy here....flooding and all. I ventured downtown by bus and when I returned from the same stop, I caught this gloomy scene....but the color brings a bleak place to life.
